Name: Seasonal Wildflowers
Author: Squiver
Description:
Adds 15 craftable wildflowers to the game - all carefully modeled after common real wildflowers - which change and age with each season for a lively, immersive bit of decoration for your farm.

Each flower will transition from bright green and budding flowers in the spring, to fully blooming summer, to barely fruiting and/or seeding autumn with subtly changing leaves, and finally, to withered and spent winter husks, covered in a delicate dusting of snow.

--------------------------------------------------------

To use, you must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] as well as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed - in addition to Smapi. When these are installed, simply download and unzip the contents into your Stardew Valley mods folder. [i](The folder technically contains two mods - the JSON mod, containing the item information itself, and the Content Patcher mod which then adds the seasonal variations. Both of these are required to run the mod successfully.)

[/i]-----------------------------------------------------------------------

All screenshots were taken with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4705]Stardew Foliage Redone - A Nature Toned Map Recolour[/url] as well as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - Reshade[/url]﻿ and my own [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5409]Realistic Wildflower Grass for More Grass[/url]﻿ grass mod - which this mod was, in part made to match.
